answer: The checkpoint that matters is Tub cooper pine cask seal entered in the barrel loft book. Clearing it means each pine cask is a measured barrel yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must, and clearing it twice means doing it all again. An alias is not free: 98 POA and 16 minutes buys one, and 529 of them costs 51842 POA and 8464 minutes. A farm can print a relic, it can fake a ocean, but it cannot backdate a orchard without the archive noticing. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
